facts.text: Jolene designed and built a sustainable water purifier for a rural community in need.

evidence.quote: I had to plan and research a lot to design and build a sustainable water purifier for a rural community in need.

facts.text: Jolene felt a sense of purpose and accomplishment after seeing the water purifier working and providing clean water to the community.

evidence.quote: Seeing it working and providing clean water to the community was incredibly satisfying. It reminded me of how engineering can make a difference in people's lives. It made me feel like I had a purpose and had done something good.

facts.text: Jolene aspires to continue working in engineering and creating sustainable solutions for communities in need.

evidence.quote: I want to keep working in engineering and continue to make a positive impact on communities in need by creating sustainable solutions.
